target: For B_n with iid uniform {-1,1} entries, there exist rho in (0,1) and n_0 such that for every n>=n_0 and t>=0, P(sqrt(n) s_min(B_n)<=t)<=t+rho^n.

primary_sources.verified_content: Inverse-norm conjecture for independent uniform +/-1 entries, coefficient one, absolute exponential remainder. Uses dimension d and exponent n in the printed formula; normalized here to dimension n.

primary_sources.title: On the Spielman-Teng Conjecture
primary_sources.authors: Ashwin Sah; Julian Sahasrabudhe; Mehtaab Sawhney
primary_sources.verified_content: Fixed real mean-zero variance-one iid subgaussian entries; uniform multiplicative error O_xi((log n)^(-1/16)) plus exp(-Omega_xi(n)). Lemma 9.2 requires a spectral cutoff and retains an additive O(delta_n epsilon) term.
